text:
kevin: quick heads up — canary v4.0.0 at 20% showing an embeddings quality drop on the \"search.retrieval\" route, started ~6m ago :mag:
deploy-bot: rollout: v4.0.0 -> 20% traffic. metrics snapshot: embedding-similarity-delta=-0.12 (baseline -0.02), p95 latency=410ms, errors=0.01%
mia: that's pretty visible on the nightly eval harness. MRR down ~0.07 on our test set, concentrated on long-tail queries.
ops-alex: note that autopilot only triggers on latency/errors. quality regressions are manual decisions. recommend pin+hold and run a focused eval across canary pods.
pm-sam: agree — high-risk for search-heavy customers. please tag support and pre-draft a customer blurb if we pause.
kevin: i'm pinning rollout at 20% and placing a manual hold now. deploy-bot: traffic pinned at 20% by kevin; autopilot rollback suppressed.
mia: running the targeted eval against the canary pods now, will post windowed MRR in ~5m.
sre-lee: logging decision metadata: reason=embed-quality-regression, action=manual-hold+eval, rollback-condition=10m sustained MRR drop >=0.08, rollback-target=v3.9.7 (build 20260501.1)
ops-alex: customer blurb draft: \"We've paused the canary for v4.0.0 after detecting a drop in retrieval relevance for a subset of traffic. We're investigating and will either resume or roll back. No customer-facing errors observed.\" pm-sam ok to send?
pm-sam: send and tag support for live watch.
deploy-bot: suggested rollback target: v3.9.7 (build 20260501.1). estimated rollback duration ~6m (rolling restarts). impact: short connection resets for affected pods.
kevin: thanks — we'll wait for the eval. if MRR confirms the delta threshold for 10m we execute rollback. i'll update in 10m. :hourglass:
